blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

faq.q: What sold in Northeast in September 2026?
faq.a: Nothing — detached: 0 solds from 2 listings; condos & townhomes: 0 listings and 0 solds, so no sales ratio applies (small-sample warning: an effectively empty shelf says nothing about values). At the Maple Ridge community level the detached median sale price was $1,131,000 and the condos & townhomes median was $525,000 (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats GVR September 2026 report).

Blue Mountain, Webster's Corners and Whonnock elementary schools and Garibaldi and Samuel Robertson Technical secondary schools are physically inside the sub-area; for the sample address 25554 Dewdney Trunk Road the SD42 locator gives Webster's Corners Elementary and Garibaldi Secondary — check any other address in the locator.

faq.q: Can an acreage home here add a suite or a second dwelling?
faq.a: One secondary suite per lot is permitted in listed zones including A-1, A-2 and A-3 if it sits inside the single detached building, is at most 40% of gross floor area and is not in the Floodplain Area; on ALR land the ALR Use Regulation also applies, and an additional separate residence is allowed only under its s.32 conditions.

faq.q: What major plan affects northeast Maple Ridge?
faq.a: The North 256 Street Industrial Lands Area Plan, approved by Council as OCP amendments, covers both sides of 256 Street north of 128 Avenue (about 500 acres); it sets future designations and does not itself approve construction.
